description: One turn of the studio chat (Story 39.3, design addendum 2026-11-07 §3.8, AD-11): the supervisor's chat route (`POST /chat {project, text}`) appends the owner's line to `_bmad-output/tracking/studio-chat.jsonl` and queues one run of this job per line on the host tier with the planner leg's model and effort (passed at enqueue) and the run's own payload `{project, project_root, seq}` (delivered with its queue `run_id`); the supervisor runs this job's worker as `claude -p` with the plugin and `--output-format stream-json`, streaming the reply text to the page. The tk-studio-engage session's `studio-reply` verb runs the tk-studio-orchestrator core headless (`orchestrate.py resolve`; the council shell only as presentation, when the line asks for the council) through `studiochat.py context`, answers from the reads the pages use, and writes one reply `{seq, at, author: planner, body, run_id, reply_to, proposals[]}` with `studiochat.py reply`. A proposal is a button the owner presses; the session moves no state, holds no bearer and no CSRF token. Shipped undeclared; the session commits nothing.
